== Summary ==
Slip “AT-AT Cannon” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 52, 1624, 336)). Version [[AT-AT Cannon (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
